name: Salsa / son
summary: Clave-driven salsa and son: tumbao bass, piano montuno, bongo martillo and congas over son clave.
keys: major or minor; the montuno vamps on I-IV-V-IV or i-iv-V-iv

harmony.notes: Montuno vamps change chords every 2 beats (beats_per_chord 2).

clave.notes: pick one direction; every part is felt against it

sounds.piano: electric_piano: Classic Tine or a piano plugin
sounds.perc: drum_sampler with bongo, conga, guiro, cowbell and claves samples

mix.notes: Natural and wide: piano and bass forward, percussion panned like a stage (bongos left, congas right), no sidechain.

do: Keep the clave direction for the whole section
Mambo: add a riff (hook) and full percussion
